title: F4 Seats (Resource Pack)
description: A resource pack for a seats datapack, which adds the visual part of the chairs.
body:
# Finnick4 Seats
This is the complimentary resource pack for my datapack, f4seats.

Use without the datapack doesn't do anything, however you to enjoy the datapack, you will have to activate this resource pack!
